images.title: Layers of a painted 4 by 4 by 4 cube
images.purpose: Show the 64 small cubes of the concept's big cube as layers, coloured by the number of painted faces, so that the corners, the edges, the face middles and the inside can be counted.
images.composition: Two 4 by 4 grids side by side, one for the top and bottom layers and one for the two middle layers, a colour key on the right and the total written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. HEADING: the text 4 × 4 × 4 = 64 small cubes in bold dark #1F2937 sans-serif (52 px) centred at (728, 80). Two square grids of 4 by 4 equal cells, each cell 80 px by 80 px with thin dark #2B2B2B cell outlines (3 px), so each grid is 320 px by 320 px. GRID 1 (the top layer and the bottom layer look the same) has its top-left corner at (150, 190) and its bottom-right corner at (470, 510). Its 16 cells: the 4 corner cells filled reddish purple #CC79A7, the 8 other cells on the edge of the grid filled amber #E69F00, the 4 middle cells filled teal #0072B2. GRID 2 (the two middle layers look the same) has its top-left corner at (560, 190) and its bottom-right corner at (880, 510). Its 16 cells: the 4 corner cells filled amber #E69F00, the 8 other cells on the edge of the grid filled teal #0072B2, the 4 middle cells filled grey #6B7280. Under Grid 1, centred at (310, 560): the text Top and bottom layers (34 px, dark). Under Grid 2, centred at (720, 560): the text Two middle layers (34 px, dark). LEGEND on the right, four rows with a colour chip (44 px square, thin dark outline) at x 960 to 1004 and the words (36 px, dark) starting at x 1024: reddish purple chip at y 230 with the words 3 faces painted: 8; amber chip at y 310 with the words 2 faces painted: 24; teal chip at y 390 with the words 1 face painted: 24; grey chip at y 470 with the words no face painted: 8. Across the bottom, centred at (728, 720): the text 8 + 24 + 24 + 8 = 64 in bold dark (80 px), the largest text in the frame. Cell counts over the two grids: reddish purple 4, amber 8 + 4 = 12, teal 4 + 8 = 12, grey 4 (each grid stands for two layers, so double them: 8, 24, 24, 8). Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any count of grids, cells or colours that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
a cell filled with a colour other than the one stated for its place
a legend number that differs from the stated number
images.takeaway: In a painted 4 by 4 by 4 cube, 8 small cubes have three painted faces, 24 have two, 24 have one and 8 have none, and together they make 64.
images.description: Two 4 by 4 grids of coloured cells for the layers of a 4 by 4 by 4 cube with a key for 3, 2, 1 and no painted faces and the total 8 + 24 + 24 + 8 = 64.
images.context: Concept image for Counting Small Cubes in a Big Cube. It shows the concept's own 4 by 4 by 4 cube and not a figure from your maths book.
images.teaching_notes: Let the child count each colour in the grids and double it for the two layers. The slip to watch is forgetting the 8 small cubes hidden inside, which have no paint.

image_decisions.why: The coloured layers are the mathematics: the child counts the cells of each colour in the two grids and doubles them to get 8, 24, 24 and 8.
